extensionDescription.message: make firefox wear a mask to look like chrome to sites that otherwise won't work.

breakageWarning.message: while chromask may help if you see a 'browser unsupported' message, it could cause unexpected breakage on some sites.

reportBrokenSite.message: if you find a site which works better with chromask enabled, please report it $IN_PRODUCT_REPORTER$ or $WEBCOMPAT$. thank you!

maskStatusOn.message: the mask is on! i pretend to be chrome on this site.

maskStatusOff.message: the mask is off. i look like firefox to this site.

maskStatusUnsupported.message: the mask cannot work on this site.

preferencesFallback.message: to adjust preferences, please open the extension manager, select chromask, and hit settings.

addSiteHostnameExplanation.message: note: always enter the full domain name. if you enter example.com, chromask will not be active on www.example.com!

addSiteErrorAlreadyActive.message: chromask is already enabled for this domain!

siteListEmpty.message: you did not enable chromask on any site yet!

shortcutsToggleMask.message: toggle the mask for the current site
